source.kind: Hunyuan 3D Pro generation (main view of the concept, drone masked out) -> hunyuan-3d-reduce-face (low, 13,514 tris) -> hunyuan-3d-part labels -> split per joint, capped, reduced locally to ~8k; legs, torso and head mirrored from the cleaner left side; texture baked from the generated model's 4K map into a 2048 atlas (own planar charts, mirrored faces share UVs, 16 colours, majority-filtered, lossless WebP (EXT_texture_webp); crosses come from the texture); joint hubs and drone scripted from the concept; packed with gltfpack -cc -kn -km -ke -ac -vp 16 -vt 16 -vn 8 -af 100 (KHR_mesh_quantization + EXT_meshopt_compression)
